description.p: Splitwave is a node-based audio router. Wire microphones, system audio, per-app capture, and audio files into a visual graph, run them through a chain of effects, then send the result to speakers or record it.

ul.li: Parametric EQ, compressor, limiter, gate and de-esser
Level meters, loudness metering and spectrum analysis

description.p: Recordings can be written as WAV, FLAC, AIFF, MP3 or Opus.

ul.li: Node graph routing for microphones, system audio, per-app capture and audio files
Effect chain with EQ, dynamics, reverb, delay, noise suppression and metering
Recording to WAV, FLAC, AIFF, MP3 or Opus
Virtual output devices backed by PipeWire null sinks
